behavior: The owner reopens an expired, partly paid invoice before its settle deadline, and the ledger counts the rest as payment until the new close
acceptance: POST .../invoices/{id}/reopen, for an expired, partly paid invoice not reopened before, with no refund under way, while now is a day or more before its settle deadline: the checkout reopens until a day before the deadline; else 409 invoice_not_reopenable

The ledger's reopen rows move the held money, up to the amount, back to the creator, each deposit's part naming its transfer; deposits until the new close count as payment; a second short close expires it again; the database allows reopen rows only between the first expiry and a second, and the status back only once

Every backend reader of the close uses the closes_at column: the ledger, the closed flag and filters, the open-invoice cap, activity's held flag and the PDF; per-deposit paid amounts count the reopen; reads return closesAt and the owner's reopenable
History gets invoice.reopened by the owner; openapi.yaml, the backend and root docs, the diagrams, D-25, D-26, R-21 and R-130 match; unit, lint and typecheck pass
